Varajlal Jiwanbhai Popat, Appeal is abated against R-2 as per Proprietor M/s.Raghuveer Provisions Court's Order dt.8.4.19. Mudholkarpeth, Ward No.54, Amravati. ..... Respondents. = = = = = = = Shri V.P.Gangane, Additional Public Prosecutor for the Appellant/State. texts.facts: 3. On 29.1.2008, the present criminal appeal was admitted. During the pendency of the present appeal, respondent No.2-Varajlal Jiwanbhai Popat, accused No.2, expired and, therefore, as per order dated 8.4.2019, the appeal against him was ordered to be disposed of as abated. On 27.9.1994, Food Inspector Suhas Sumant Kulkarni (PW2) visited shop named and style as Raghuveer Provisions situated at Mudholkarpeth, Ward No.54, Amravati. He is .....3/- Judgment apeal468.06 20 complainant. He disclosed his identity and intention to purchase food sample for sending it for its analysis from said Raghuveer Provisions. Accordingly, he obtained sample of Suji/Rava and paid amount to accused No.1-Nitin. He divided the sample in 3 equal parts. The sample of Suji/Rava was sent to Public Analyst who reported that said sample does not conform standard of "Semolina" and was "Insect Infested". Having received such report through Local Health Authority, the Food Inspector forwarded the matter for obtaining necessary sanction from the Joint Commissioner, Amravati Division, Food and Drug Administration, Maharashtra State. Having armed with the consent, complaint was filed. To prove the charge of the accused persons, 3 witnesses were examined and they are Local Health Authority Mannalal Kisanlal Gattani (PW1), complainant Food Inspector Suhas Kulkarni (PW2), and panch witness Tarachand Nandramji Killekar (PW3). 6. After appreciation of the prosecution case, learned Magistrate acquitted accused Nos.1 and 2. 7. By now, law is well settled that merely because .....4/- 8. In the present case, the accused purchased Suji/Rava from Vijaykimar & Co. at Amravati on 16.8.1994. Whereas, the complainant collected the sample on 27.9.1994. According to the defence of the accused, he sold Rava/Suji in the same state in which the said was purchased. The sample of the Rava/Suji was taken after 43 days by the Food Inspector. State Of Maharashtra At The Instance Of ... vs Nitin Varajlal Popat & Anor on 14 June, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18390196/ 2 9 . The sample of Rava/Suji was collected on 27.9.1994 and the said was sent on 28.9.1994. Report (Exhibit 44) shows that the sample was receive with Office of Public Analyst on 1.10.1994 and the report is signed on 27.10.1994. The report does not state as to when the sample was opened and analyzed. However, from the report it is clear that after good 26 days, the .....5/- Judgment apeal468.06 20 sample was with C.A. 10. Learned Magistrate, in my view, correctly observed that the Food Inspector failed to mention how many larvae were found on the day of collecting the sample. As per Report (Exhibit 44), 26 larvae were found to be alive and 20 were found to be dead.
